window.basis: Observed teaser through last retrieved 2024 clip; an analytical boundary, not an official campaign end.

coverage.note: Uploads playlist exhausted. OAC/linked uploads may exceed the channel publicVideoCount. Not a census of Topic, partner or fan channels.

history.note: The same channel total repeats from 15 Oct to 8 Nov, followed by a refresh jump on 9 Nov. Do not interpret the displayed 910,965 delta as seven days of consumption or attribute it to an asset. No 2023–24 subscriber history is available.

limitations: Lifetime asset views as at capture, not views earned during the campaign.
No matched-age performance, paid/organic split, CTR, retention, unique viewers or asset-level subscriber attribution.
Short clips use the legacy duration proxy, not a verified Shorts-feed classification. 2024 and 2026 Shorts view definitions differ; do not compare raw counts across those periods.
No inference of platform eligibility, confirmed partner support, next-release date, production rights or clearance from public counts.
